thesis: Pan American Silver is the largest primary silver producer in the Americas and a mid-tier gold producer, with a 44% JV interest in the high-grade Juanicipio mine acquired with MAG Silver in September 2025 pulling H1 2026 Silver Segment AISC down to $12.64/oz against full-year guidance of $15.75-$18.25/oz. H1 2026 attributable free cash flow was $832M, the balance sheet holds $1.8B of cash and short-term investments against $841M of total debt, and management is returning up to $1B to shareholders in 2026 via a $0.184 quarterly dividend and buybacks (~7.3M shares retired at an average $49.22). The stock trades at ~12x the $3.81 FY2026 consensus and ~9x the $5.00 FY2027 consensus after silver fell ~49% from its $121.62/oz January 2026 peak to ~$62/oz. The offsetting concerns are that gold — the larger revenue line — is tracking to the low end of guidance on Jacobina seismicity mitigation and El Penon grade continuity, and that every valuation case here is ultimately a silver-price case.
